itinerary.name: Day 1: Arrival & Sugandha Sunset Seafood BBQ
itinerary.description: Hotel check-in at Kolatoli, authentic seafood lunch at Poushee, Sugandha beach sunset, and live charcoal fish grill.

itinerary.description: 80km scenic highway ride, Himchari hilltop panorama, Inani coral beach walk, beachfront parasailing, and Mermaid twilight cafe.

itinerary.name: Day 3: Moheshkhali Island Speedboat & Adinath Shrine
itinerary.description: Speedboat sea crossing, ancient Adinath temple, Buddhist golden pagodas, and Barmis souvenir market shopping.

mainEntity.name: How much does a 3-day trip to Cox's Bazar cost for 2 people?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard comfortable 3-day trip for 2 people typically costs between ৳18,000 and ৳22,000 BDT ($150 - $185 USD), covering an AC sea-facing room, authentic seafood feasts, local transit, and activities.

mainEntity.name: What is the fair transit fare from Kolatoli to Inani Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: The verified anti-scam reserve fare for a CNG auto-rickshaw from Kolatoli or Town Central to Inani Beach along Marine Drive is ৳500 to ৳600 BDT. Do not pay inflated rates of ৳1,000+.
